payload.rationale: The brief sets the reader at the comparing stage, so Wedded Concierge is the primary CTA (services.md: comparing leads to a Concierge consultation). The primary link sits directly after the at-a-glance table, where the reader has just weighed a cool European spring against a warm, wet island; its sentence carries the brand-facts claim that the Wedded Advisor confirms inclusions in writing before the couple commits, which the panel moved here so skimmers meet the accountability line early. The secondary link closes the practical planning section for the reader ready to turn a shortlist into dates and venues, and the closing section repeats the invitation with the single point of contact claim and asks for date, guest numbers, privacy needs and who needs a hand on the journey, which funding_parent and planner_couple named as the line that spoke to them. The /magazine link exists in the link map (lead magnet) and serves planner_couple and search_visitor, who said they would bookmark rather than enquire today. All four links are kept exactly as placed, each anchor 'Wedded Concierge' (2 words, no exclamation mark) or 'Wedded Wonderland magazine'. Panel enquiry likelihood was 1.8: four personas said 'maybe' and uhnw said 'no'. The questions behind those reactions are not confirmed in brand-facts.md, so nothing is added to the post and no copy change is flagged; they are routed to /wonderland-concierge (see open_questions).
